cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# Simulate the public check's structural validation exactly.
import stat, os
from pathlib import Path
project = Path('/workspace/project').absolute()
assert not project.is_symlink() and project.is_dir()
total = 0; entries = 0
for path in project.rglob("*"):
    info = path.lstat(); entries += 1
    assert not path.is_symlink(), path
    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode), path
    if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        assert info.st_nlink == 1, (path, info.st_nlink)
        total += info.st_size
assert total <= 8 * 1024 * 1024 and entries <= 256, (total, entries)
candidate = project / "campaign_cli.py"
candidate.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
print("structure OK: %d entries, %d bytes" % (entries, total))
PYEOF
ls -la /workspace/project /workspace/project/src/eywa /workspace/project/tests 2>/dev/null | head -30
